title: Response extractors specialized to actual public output and shorter seeds

claims.statement: Joint CircuitBreaker theorem under rules.md: the following declaration defines ONE fixed eligible total uniform NP family in the pinned full B2 model at actual input length n. Its full guarantee and its declared projection both hold unconditionally, for all sufficiently large integer lengths with the quantifiers specified by the theorem kinds. Both score source claims assert this ENTIRE declaration, not separate lemmas. For g(n)=c*n^p*(log2 n)^q*(log2 log2 n)^r with the exact parameters in guarantee, liminf over all integer n of C_B2(f_n)/g(n) >= 1. Equivalently, for every epsilon>0 there is N_epsilon such that C_B2(f_n)>=(1-epsilon)*g(n) for every integer n>=N_epsilon. The controller enumerates BASE then the SIX public rational coordinates(h,a,wm,w0,X,p) with denominators<=B in the exact ranges/prefilter in family.py. No trial D coordinate is searched. Each tuple uses W0=ceil(w0Z),Wnext=max(ceil(wmZ),W-ceil_log2(2b)) with actual public b,and the supplied local tree; H is the last planned active level. All primitive/context/row/confidence guards remain. The pure minimum_geometry_dimension computes the exact least integer d satisfying the finite geometry predicates,using C=1+sum_u(2^(active log gap_u)-1),S=ceil(d/C),ordinary2b/2t,products from first positive active depth,rank=ell*P*sum_(j<H)(2^A_j-1),and d_min=1+C*(Q-1) for the closed integer maximum Q proved in proof.md. Reject d>N; otherwise check the independent geometry predicate and exact dyadic primitive-error/output-event inequalities. Choose smallest accepted d,ties first enumerated; set d_N=d and evaluate the supplied challenge-response tree. No accepted tuple means output0,d_N=N+1. Responses use actual public output ell*P;blocks keep floor(K^beta). SU uses least odd prime s with2^s>2^30*h*d*s*(32m)^4,s<=(L+1)^2;public mode caps2,3,4,5,6 apply on successive rate bins ending.19,.3,.4,.48,.52. All fields,Singer/code/design/row/block procedures and complete correctness/runtime proofs are supplied. Context bits and exact arithmetic are charged. Define S6 by the six rational ranges,strict analytic_prefilter and existence of a finite increasing-potential box certificate>1,exactly specified in proof.md. Let Cstar6=inf_(h,a,wm,w0,X,p in S6)(w0+X). Then limsup over all integer N of log2(d_N)/Z<=Cstar6<=88189/20000=4.40945. There is N0 such that for EVERY integer N>=N0,C_B2(F_N)>=4N-8*2^ceil(8819Z/2000)+4. For this SAME family,for EVERY fixed real epsilon>0 there is N_epsilon such that C_B2(F_N)>=4N-N^epsilon for EVERY integer N>=N_epsilon. Thus liminf C_B2(F_N)/N>=4 at actual length in the unrestricted pinned full-B2 model. The exact dimension is least for its supplied geometry predicates,and its certified finite lower bounds dominate those from the counterfactual seven-coordinate,global-product and coarse-rank controllers on the SAME plans at every N,as proved directly from the predicates;this does not compare actual complexities of different languages or assume a previous judgment. Certified dimensions also dominate the default-capacity response controller on identical block plans. The SU degree is least for its finite predictor guard and no larger than before. The six-axis grid,all rejected paths and exact arithmetic have fixed polynomial time in N. Eventual acceptance is proved separately for each fixed feasible tuple before taking infima;no uniform threshold over shrinking grid margins is assumed. No eventual boundary4.40945 bound,explicit threshold,numerical optimality beyond the stated certificate,literature record or practical accepted full-tree execution is claimed.","version":"circuitbreaker-expression-v1"}
